articles.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
articles.description: The revelations in Anthropic's threat intelligence report come after a former top researcher at the company warned of the risks of AI to humanity.
articles.titleJa: AnthropicがAIによる生物兵器製造の可能性のある試みを阻止
articles.summary: AI企業Anthropicが、AIを用いた生物兵器製造の試みを阻止したと報告。AIが人類にもたらすリスクに関する懸念が高まる中での発表である。

articles.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists sentenced to up to seven years in prison
articles.description: Hong Kong used to be one of the only places in Chinese territory where people could gather to mark the 1989 crackdown.
articles.titleJa: 香港の天安門活動家らが最長7年の禁錮刑を宣告
articles.summary: 香港で天安門事件の追悼集会を組織した活動家らが、最長7年の禁錮刑を言い渡された。かつて中国領内で唯一追悼が許された場所での自由が失われつつある。

articles.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
articles.description: The powerful blast registered as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.
articles.titleJa: イスラエル、ヒズボラの主要地下基地を破壊と発表
articles.summary: イスラエルは、レバノンのイスラム教シーア派組織ヒズボラの主要な地下基地を破壊したと発表。爆発はマグニチュード4.1の地震に相当する規模だった。

articles.title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
articles.description: Thai police also arrested a suspected female accomplice with whom the monk, who had taken a vow of celibacy, was filmed having sex.
articles.titleJa: 仏教僧侶、300万ドルの横領疑惑で逮捕
articles.summary: タイで、貞潔の誓いを立てた仏教僧侶が300万ドルの横領と女性共犯者との性行為の容疑で逮捕された。タイ警察が捜査を進めている。

articles.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
articles.description: Auction house Sotheby's expects the dress to sell for up to $300,000 (£220,000) when it goes under the hammer on 9 December.
articles.titleJa: ダイアナ妃の「リベンジドレス」がオークションに出品
articles.summary: ダイアナ妃が着用した有名な「リベンジドレス」がサザビーズでオークションにかけられる。予想落札価格は最大30万ドルに達する見込み。

articles.title: Philippine rescuers board ferry 40 hours after blaze began
articles.description: Thick, toxic fumes and extreme temperatures pose a challenge to rescuers who have boarded the ship.
articles.titleJa: フィリピンの救助隊、火災発生から40時間後にフェリーに乗り込む
articles.summary: フィリピンで火災に見舞われたフェリーに、火災発生から40時間後に救助隊が乗り込んだ。有毒ガスと高熱が救助活動を困難にしている。

articles.title: Six Nigerians accused of romance scams to be extradited to the US
articles.description: The six will face wire fraud and money-laundry charges in the US, South African police say.
articles.titleJa: ロマンス詐欺の疑いのあるナイジェリア人6名が米国へ引き渡しへ
articles.summary: ロマンス詐欺とマネーロンダリングの罪に問われているナイジェリア人6名が、南アフリカ警察によって米国に引き渡される予定。

articles.title: Five dead and dozens injured in coach crash in Swiss Alps
articles.description: The tourist coach was carrying dozens of Dutch passengers when it overturned in the south-eastern Swiss Alps.
articles.titleJa: スイスアルプスで観光バスが衝突、5人死亡、数十人負傷
articles.summary: スイスアルプスで観光バスが横転し、乗客5人が死亡、数十人が負傷した。バスには多数のオランダ人観光客が乗っていた。

articles.title: Man jailed after threatening to behead son's teacher in French village
articles.description: The father had threatened to kill a female primary school teacher for disciplining his son in class.
articles.titleJa: フランスの村で息子を叱った教師を脅迫した男が投獄
articles.summary: フランスの村で、息子を懲戒した小学校教師を斬首すると脅迫した父親が逮捕され、投獄された。地元の学校では安全対策が強化されている。

articles.title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend
articles.description: Singapore's High Court rules in the woman's favour, with the judge saying the man "willingly" showered her with gifts, even before they got together.
articles.titleJa: 元交際相手への高額贈与36万9千ドルの返還請求訴訟で男性が敗訴
articles.summary: シンガポールの高等裁判所は、元交際相手に贈った36万9千ドルの返還を求める男性の訴えを退けた。裁判官は男性が自発的に贈り物を与えたと判断した。

articles.title: India's BRICS strategy tested with Xi, Putin set to visit
articles.description: New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.
articles.titleJa: インドのBRICS戦略、習主席とプーチン大統領の訪問で試練に
articles.summary: インドは習主席とプーチン大統領の訪問を控え、BRICSを反西側プラットフォームにしないよう、中国・ロシアとの関係深化とバランスを取る戦略が試されている。

articles.title: Uber leaves two key African markets — and their drivers in despair
articles.description: Uber's departure from Nigeria and Uganda has left countless customers high and dry. But what about drivers? With fuel prices, maintenance and other operating costs rising, many say they're struggling to make a living.
articles.titleJa: ウーバーがアフリカの主要2市場から撤退、ドライバーたちは絶望
articles.summary: ウーバーがナイジェリアとウガンダから撤退し、顧客だけでなく、燃料費高騰などで生活に苦しむ多数のドライバーが職を失い、絶望している。

articles.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Putin, Modi reaffirm partnership
articles.description: Modi will also meet Xi Jinping as India seeks to balance ties with China and Russia. The wars in Ukraine and Iran could test the group's unity at the summit. Follow DW for more.
articles.titleJa: BRICSサミット2026：プーチン大統領とモディ首相がパートナーシップを再確認
articles.summary: BRICSサミットでプーチン大統領とモディ首相が連携を確認。インドは中国とロシアとの関係を均衡させようとし、ウクライナ・イラン戦争がグループの結束を試す。

articles.title: Iran war: Saudi-Houthi escalation intensifies Yemen conflict
articles.description: The Houthi takeovers of Mokha, Dhubab and Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait threaten to push Yemen deeper into the Middle East war. The Iran-backed group has made advances against Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia.
articles.titleJa: イラン戦争：サウジとフーシ派の緊張激化でイエメン紛争が深まる
articles.summary: フーシ派が戦略的なバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡の要衝を掌握し、イエメン紛争が中東戦争に深く引き込まれる危険性が高まっている。

articles.title: Germany charges 7 suspected Hamas members over attack plot
articles.description: Prosecutors say the suspects had moved beyond general preparations and were already pursuing a concrete plan for a deadly attack on Israeli or Jewish targets.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ、ハマス関係者とされる7人を攻撃計画容疑で訴追
articles.summary: ドイツ検察当局は、イスラエル人またはユダヤ人を標的とした具体的な攻撃計画を企てていたとして、ハマス関係者とされる7人を訴追した。

articles.title: 9/11 conspiracy theories that continue to circulate
articles.description: A quarter-century after the September 11, 2001, attacks, they are still the focus of numerous conspiracy theories. Why do people believe them?
articles.titleJa: 依然として流布する9/11陰謀論
articles.summary: 2001年の9月11日攻撃から四半世紀が経った今も、数多くの陰謀論が飛び交っている。なぜ人々はそれらを信じるのかを考察。

articles.title: India looks to steer BRICS away from anti-Western turn
articles.description: The BRICS summit 2026 takes place in Delhi this weekend. Unlike last year, Putin and Xi are expected to attend. Can India keep the expanded bloc united?
articles.titleJa: インド、BRICSを反西側路線から遠ざけようと模索
articles.summary: 今週末デリーで開催されるBRICSサミットで、インドは拡大したブロックの結束を保ちつつ、反西側路線への傾倒を避けるよう努める。プーチン、習両主席も出席予定。

articles.title: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
articles.description: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
articles.titleJa: なぜ北朝鮮の金正恩は米国との取引を必要としないのか
articles.summary: ドナルド・トランプの北朝鮮への接近は実を結ばず、平壌は核開発を加速させ、ロシア・中国との同盟を強化しており、米国との取引を不要としている。

articles.title: Yemen: Houthis tighten control of strategic Red Sea towns
articles.description: Reports indicate Houthi militants have taken over the port city of Mokha along with Perim Island, which occupies a strategic position on a vital transport waterway in the Red Sea.
articles.titleJa: イエメン：フーシ派が紅海の戦略的都市の支配を強化
articles.summary: フーシ派が紅海の重要な輸送水路に位置する港湾都市モカとペリム島の支配を強化したと報じられ、紛争の戦略的状況が変化している。

articles.title: Turks in Germany anxious after AfD wins in Saxony-Anhalt
articles.description: The Alternative for Germany party's win in Saxony-Anhalt has alarmed people of Turkish origin in eastern states. Will workers and business owners abandon the increasingly AfD-friendly region for the more welcoming west?
articles.titleJa: ドイツのトルコ系住民、ザクセン＝アンハルト州でのAfD勝利に不安
articles.summary: ドイツのザクセン＝アンハルト州でのAfDの勝利を受け、東部のトルコ系住民に不安が広がり、より友好的な西部への移住を検討する労働者や事業主もいる。

articles.title: $15m fund launched to create ‘unstoppable momentum’ to end FGM worldwide
articles.description:
Her Horizon Fund seeks $100m to stop practice harming 230m women and girls globally  
Frontline activists and leaders in the fight against female genital mutilation, which has affected more than 230 million women and girls worldwide, have welcomed an unprecedented $15.5m (£11.4m) fund aimed at creating “unstoppable momentum” to finally end the practice.
The launch of the fund comes as women’s rights are increasingly under attack and donor funding is in sharp decline, particularly for work led by FGM survivors in local communities. It is thought to be the largest single philanthropic contribution to ending the practice of FGM.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: FGM撲滅に向けた1500万ドルの基金が発足、「止められない勢い」を生み出す
articles.summary: 世界中で2億3000万人以上の女性に影響を及ぼす女性器切除（FGM）を終わらせるため、「Her Horizon Fund」が1550万ドルを立ち上げ、運動に「止められない勢い」を生み出すことを目指す。

articles.title: Secret son revelation ignites bitter succession dispute in Ugandan kingdom
articles.description:
Family of late King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV reject committee’s choice of cousin and TV presenter as new monarch
A traditional Ugandan kingdom has become engulfed in a bitter succession dispute after the family of a king who recently died rejected the selection of a television news anchor as his successor.
King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, who became the world’s youngest reigning monarch when he took the throne in the kingdom of Tooro in 1995 at the age of three, died on 27 August in the US, where he was receiving cancer treatment.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 秘密の息子発覚がウガンダ王国で激しい王位継承争いを点火
articles.summary: ウガンダのトーロ王国で、故オヨ・ニンバ・カバンバ・イグル・ルキディ4世の死後、秘密の息子が発覚し、王族がテレビ司会者を後継者に選んだことを拒否、激しい王位継承争いが勃発している。

articles.title: Uganda to withdraw from Invictus Games ‘out of respect for King Charles’, says military chief
articles.description:
Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba announces decision to pull out in post on X, citing tensions over ‘Harry-Meghan nonsense’
Uganda is withdrawing from the Duke of Sussex’s Invictus Games, the country’s military chief has said, out of respect for King Charles amid division over the “Harry-Meghan nonsense”.
Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba, son of the Ugandan president, made the surprise announcement in a post on X on Wednesday.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ウガンダ、インビクタス・ゲームからの撤退を発表。「チャールズ国王への敬意のため」と軍司令官
articles.summary: ウガンダの軍司令官は、チャールズ国王への敬意と「ハリー・メーガンの騒動」を理由に、同国がハリー王子が主催するインビクタス・ゲームから撤退するとXで発表した。

articles.title: Babies born to anaemic mothers have smaller brains, study finds
articles.description:
Key regions of the brain linked to movement, learning and emotions were affected and may lead to cognitive problems 
Babies born to mothers with anaemia have smaller brains, particularly in key regions linked to movement, learning and the regulation of emotion, according to a study.
Researchers said the differences, first detected at the age of one, could lead to cognitive problems when children started school.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 貧血の母親から生まれた赤ちゃんは脳が小さいことが研究で判明
articles.summary: 研究により、貧血の母親から生まれた赤ちゃんは、運動、学習、感情の調節に関連する主要な脳領域が小さく、これが将来の認知問題につながる可能性があることが明らかになった。

articles.title: Hijacking pirates exploit regional chaos to return to seas off Somalia
articles.description:
US-Israel war on Iran and political instability in Somalia lead to pirates targeting cargo ships off Horn of Africa
The scourge of Somali piracy targeting cargo ships and smaller dhows off the Horn of Africa has returned to levels not seen in a decade, driven by a convergence of factors including disruptions to the shipping industry caused by the US-Israeli war against Iran and a resurgence of political instability in Somalia.
Since late April there have been eight hijackings by Somali pirates, including two within the space of a fortnight in August: one targeting an oil tanker with ties to Iran, the other a Cameroon-flagged vessel, the Lutuf, carrying military equipment for Turkey.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 海賊が地域の混乱を利用し、ソマリア沖の海域に再び出現
articles.summary: 米イスラエルとイランの紛争による海運業への影響やソマリアの政情不安により、ソマリア沖での海賊行為が10年ぶりの高水準に達し、貨物船が再び標的となっている。

articles.title: Canada offers air defense support for Ukraine as Zelenskyy visits
articles.description:
Canadian PM Mark Carney hosts president in Calgary, where he grew up alongside large Ukrainian community
Canada offered support on Thursday to boost Ukraine’s air defenses and help replenish its drone stocks, as the countries pledged to deepen their alliance during a visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Mark Carney hosted the president of Ukraine in Calgary in the western province of Alberta, where the Canadian prime minister grew up among a large community of people with Ukrainian heritage.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ゼレンスキー訪問中にカナダがウクライナに防空支援を申し出る
articles.summary: ゼレンスキー大統領のカナダ訪問中、両国は同盟を深めることを誓い、カナダはウクライナの防空能力強化とドローン在庫補充への支援を申し出た。

articles.title: Rubio signals shift to working with allies to fight drug trade as latest boat strike kills three
articles.description:
Rubio visits Ecuador and welcomes cooperation after campaign of unilateral strikes on alleged ‘narco-terrorists’
The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, gave new clarity on the approach toward combating drug trafficking in Latin American waters, saying the Trump administration was focused on working with allied countries and aligning with their laws but insisted the military would “still blow up ships if need be”.
The public acknowledgment of a shift in US strategy comes a year after Washington began a campaign of unilateral deadly strikes against those it calls “narco-terrorists” operating boats in international waters.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ルビオ、麻薬取引対策で同盟国との協力へ転換を示唆、最新の船舶攻撃で3人死亡
articles.summary: 米国務長官ルビオは、ラテンアメリカの麻薬密売対策において、同盟国との協力に重点を置く新戦略を示唆し、過去の単独攻撃とは異なるアプローチを示した。

articles.title: Notorious Ecuadorian crime gang designated a terrorist group by US
articles.description:
Trump administration to seek extra funding from Congress to ‘dismantle’ Los Tiguerones over narcotics trafficking
The US has designated Ecuador’s Los Tiguerones gang, which stormed a television station during a live broadcast in 2024, as a terrorist organisation as the Trump administration expands its campaign against narcotics traffickers it says are destabilising Latin America.
The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, made the announcement in Quito, where he met Ecuadorian president Daniel Noboa, one of several rightwing allies of Donald Trump whom Rubio is courting as a security partner during a three-nation tour through Latin America that began on Tuesday.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エクアドルの悪名高い犯罪組織、米国によりテロ組織に指定される
articles.summary: 米国は、2024年にテレビ局を襲撃したエクアドルのギャング「ロス・ティグエロネス」をテロ組織に指定し、ラテンアメリカの不安定化を招く麻薬密売人に対するキャンペーンを拡大する。

articles.title: Family of British man found dead in Grenada ask local police to work with UK investigators
articles.description:
Andrew Frederick’s body was found in property he was staying at in Grenada in January
The family of a British father who was found dead in the Caribbean in January is urging authorities in Grenada to work with UK police to uncover the truth about his death.
Andrew Frederick’s body was found in the property he was staying at in Grenada on 4 January. An autopsy, performed in the same week by a privately hired pathologist, concluded that the 47-year-old’s death was a homicide.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: グレナダで死亡した英国人男性の家族、現地警察に英国捜査官との協力を要請
articles.summary: グレナダで1月に遺体で発見された英国人男性アンドリュー・フレデリックさんの家族が、死の真相究明のため、グレナダ当局に対し英国警察との協力を強く求めている。

articles.title: ‘It’s hell’: father of slain Australian surfers tells Mexico homicide trial about identifying sons’ bodies
articles.description:
Three men are on trial over the death of brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend, US citizen Jack Carter Rhoad, in Ensenada
The father of two Australian surfers killed in Mexico two years ago testified in court on Tuesday that his life had been turned into hell, as the high-profile trial continued into its second day.
Three men are charged in the killing of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, aged 30 and 33, respectively, and their 30-year-old American friend Jack Carter Rhoad, who were on a surfing trip to Mexico’s Pacific coast in April 2024.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「地獄だ」：殺害されたオーストラリア人サーファーの父親、メキシコの殺人裁判で息子たちの遺体確認について語る
articles.summary: メキシコでの裁判で、2年前に殺害されたオーストラリア人サーファー兄弟と米国人友人の父親が、息子たちの遺体を確認した際の「地獄」のような体験を証言した。

articles.title: Houthis seize key Yemeni island in Bab el-Mandeb, taking control of the strait
articles.description: Houthi fighters reached Perim Island which divides the Bab el-Mandeb into two shipping lanes after government forces withdrew, completing the group's takeover of the strait. Together with Iran's Hormuz blockade, this puts roughly a third of the world's seaborne trade under hostile control.
articles.titleJa: フーシ派がイエメンの要衝マンデブ海峡の島を占領、海峡の支配権を掌握
articles.summary: フーシ派がマンデブ海峡を分けるペリム島を制圧し、海峡の支配を完了。これにより、世界の海上貿易の約3分の1が敵対勢力の支配下に置かれることに。

articles.title: France cuts growth forecast as economy lags behind European neighbours
articles.description: It comes after France's national statistics office lowered its forecast for 2026 growth from 0.7% to 0.4% and warned that the French economy was "losing ground."
articles.titleJa: フランス、経済が欧州近隣諸国に遅れ、成長予測を下方修正
articles.summary: フランスの統計局が2026年の成長予測を0.7%から0.4%に引き下げ、「フランス経済が失速している」と警告した。

articles.title: EU pledges €6.1bn for Ukraine, including aid for Patriot interceptors
articles.description: Brussels is trying to persuade EU countries that still have Patriot interceptors in their national stockpiles to donate them to Ukraine and replace them at a later stage with deliveries scheduled for 2027.
articles.titleJa: EU、ウクライナに61億ユーロを約束、パトリオット迎撃ミサイル支援も含む
articles.summary: EUがウクライナに対し61億ユーロの支援を表明。パトリオット迎撃ミサイルの供与も含まれ、EU加盟国に自国備蓄からの提供を促している。

articles.title: EU needs to 'pin down' Ukraine's exact budget needs, Dombrovskis tells Euronews
articles.description: In an interview with Euronews, Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis says the "open questions" surrounding Ukraine's budget needs must first be clarified. Kyiv has asked its allies to plug a €23 billion funding shortfall.
articles.titleJa: EU、ウクライナの正確な予算ニーズを「明確にする必要」があるとドムブロフスキス氏が語る
articles.summary: ドムブロフスキス委員は、ウクライナの230億ユーロの資金不足に関する「未解決の疑問」をまず明確にすべきだと述べた。

articles.title: US inflation holds at 3.4% as monthly price rises hit fastest pace since May
articles.description: US consumer prices rose 3.4% in the year to August, unchanged from July and exactly in line with expectations, but the monthly increase of 0.4% was the sharpest since May, a sign the energy shock is starting to bite four days before a Federal Reserve decision markets expect will deliver a rate hike.
articles.titleJa: 米国インフレ率3.4%維持、月間物価上昇は5月以来の速さに
articles.summary: 米国の消費者物価は8月まで年間3.4%上昇で推移。月間上昇率は5月以来の速さで、エネルギー価格ショックの影響が出始めている兆候だ。

articles.title: Kyrgyzstan hosts Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit as bloc expands its global role
articles.description: World leaders gathered in Bishkek for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation’s 25th anniversary summit, as Kyrgyzstan concluded its year as chair.
articles.titleJa: キルギス、上海協力機構首脳会議を開催、ブロックが世界的役割を拡大
articles.summary: キルギスが議長国を務めた上海協力機構の25周年記念首脳会議がビシュケクで開催。世界各国から首脳が集まり、同機構の世界的役割拡大について議論された。

articles.title: From bottle stoppers to rockets: How Portugal is reinventing cork
articles.description: Portugal produces around half of the world’s cork. Here, the world’s largest cork company, Corticeira Amorim, continues to open new markets by transforming this ancient natural resource into high-tech materials. In this report, we explore its  methods, from harvesting to production.
articles.titleJa: ボトルストッパーからロケットまで：ポルトガルがいかにコルクを再発明しているか
articles.summary: 世界のコルクの半分を生産するポルトガルが、古来の天然資源をハイテク素材に変え、新たな市場を開拓している様子をレポート。

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds

articles.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice

articles.titleJa: マダガスカルが特定の種類の米に対するセーフガード調査を開始

articles.title: Trade finance: how volatile financial conditions influence its availability and impact trade levels
articles.description: Global trade opens opportunities for economic growth. However, moving goods across borders, between exporters and importers, involves counterparty risk such as payment and liquidity risk. Trade finance facilitates trade by mitigating these risks.Using a new dataset, we find that volatile global financial conditions constrict the availability of trade finance, especially in emerging markets and developing countries. In addition, the level of development of local financial markets influences the supply of trade finance by global institutions.
articles.titleJa: 貿易金融：変動の激しい金融状況がその利用可能性と貿易水準に与える影響

articles.title: WTO concludes advanced workshop on agriculture notifications

articles.titleJa: WTOが農業通報に関する上級ワークショップを終了
